name: lead-enrichment
description: Fixed five-call, read-only full-contact B2B lead cross-check. Requires a coherent name, company, domain, known work email, and LinkedIn person URL; independently finds an email candidate, verifies the supplied email, enriches professional identity, explicitly requests phone enrichment, and retrieves company firmographics.

firstName.description: Lead first name. Must identify the same person as linkedinUrl and email.

lastName.description: Lead last name. Must identify the same person as linkedinUrl and email.

company.description: Current employer name matching domain and the LinkedIn profile.

domain.description: Bare employer domain matching the supplied work email, e.g. acme.com.

email.description: Known work email to verify independently; its suffix must match domain.

linkedinUrl.description: LinkedIn person-profile URL for the same lead; required for identity and phone matching.

steps.label: derive work-email candidate — Hunter email finder (MPP on Tempo)
verify supplied work email — Hunter email verifier (MPP on Tempo)
professional identity cross-check — Apollo people enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
business-phone enrichment — Clado contacts (MPP on Tempo)
employer firmographics — Hunter company enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
